Workflow folder permissions is only available on the Introducing the Eleva Founder Plan & above.

Restrict access to any folder containing workflows with Folder Permissions

Workflow Folder Permissions let you control which users can access workflows within a specific folder. This helps prevent unauthorized users from viewing or modifying restricted workflows.

How-to Add Folder Permissions Within a Workflow Folder

  1. Navigate to Automation > Workflows.

  2. Locate an existing workflow folder or create a new folder.

  3. Open the folder's Actions menu.

  4. Select Manage Permissions.

  5. Choose the User Type & Role allowed to access the folder.

  6. Save the changes, if prompted.

Note: Folder permissions do not necessarily restrict workflow-related actions on the Contact Details page. Depending on their other permissions, users may still be able to view a contact's workflow memberships and add or remove contacts from workflows.
